newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate flat at 11.3 pct, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate flat at 11.3 pct, trade thin.

text.p: The Croatina average lending rate was flat at 11.3 percent in thin trade and amid weak demand for kuna funds, dealers said.
Turnover shrank to 12.3 million kuna from Wednesday's 57 million, leaving a surplus of 37.7 million on the supply side.
Only four million kuna were fresh borrowings, of which three million were call money loans granted at a steady 11 percent. The rest were two short-term borrowings granted at 14 and 16 percent.
Insurerers rolled over previous 4.8 million kuna loans at a steady 10 percent.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Friday slightly firmer at 5.8345 against the dollar and 3.5635 against the mark. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
